hook_form.value: A claim-first mystery in animal terms: L1 leads with the claim's strangest true form — "a warning began outrunning the animal it warned about" — instead of the event (v1 opened on a human first speaking and saved the claim for L4). The admitted uncertainty in the same breath ("nobody knows when") is itself the pattern-break: honesty as the hook (the batch's only line-1 confession; §8 variation 2). The packaging is DR-1: title "Faster Than Feet" (a race result with the winner missing), cover frame the L4 fire scene — one speaker, the ring of listeners, route landmarks faint beyond the firelight — cover line "ONE BREATH. TEN MINDS.", with the named fallback (the lone dawn figure, L1's scene) if the frame reads busy at 180 px. The continue is DR-2's re-earn map: L3 the stopwatch, L4 the cargo, L5 the race called, L6 the reversal. The piece's tested delivery variation rides the hook: the performed-voice open — L1 delivered as the first spoken thought, the medium demonstrating the message — against the Ep.1 control (§8 variation 1, kept from v1).

orientation_line.value: Fused into the opening beat — there is no separate orientation line, by declared design: the N-02 orientation log (v2 §6) places all four orientation beats inside the first beat. Where — the deep human past, over 100,000 years ago, before any record (L1's time anchor + the opening card). Who — the warned animal's world: hunters and the hunted; the first speaker arrives at L4. Vibe — quiet wonder at walking pace, about to be outrun (dawn scene; L2's feet). What to watch — what speech CHANGED: the speed of a warning (planted L1, measured L3). Time is stated in L1 WITH its uncertainty — the Earth One rule (state what time it is) read honestly: where the time is genuinely unknown, the piece says that instead of borrowing a false date.
